topic: The six fields inside a Bitcoin block header
hook: Every Bitcoin block is judged by just six fields.

scenes.narration: A block header is a compact 80-byte bundle. It holds six fields: version, previous block hash, merkle root, timestamp, difficulty bits and a nonce.
The previous block hash links it to the block before. The merkle root commits to every transaction inside the block.
The nonce is a counter miners keep changing while they search for a hash that meets the target.

cta: Which field surprised you? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: What Is Inside a Bitcoin Block Header?
description_body: A block header is 80 bytes with six fields. See what each one does.
